scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.celular: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server -- --lan" "npm run dev -w web -- --host"
